content.comment_body: Hello, I would like to find out if it is possible to connect two [product_name]s ([version_no]) to transfer data from the SD card of one device to the other. Specifically, one device would act as a stationary data logger, while the other, installed in a truck, connects to retrieve all stored data onto its own SD card. Thanks for any assistance.

A direct transfer of logged data between SD cards on two [product_name] devices through normal connections is not supported. This kind of transfer can only be accomplished by using a PC to copy data from one SD card to another.
Thanks for your response. I will need to explore alternative solutions.
A new question published by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'how can log data into excel from [product_name] PLC?'. Best regards, [user_name]
Hi, did you ever find a solution for this? I have a similar issue.

analysis.insight_summary: Users determined that [product_name] ([version_no]) devices do not support automatic SD card data transfer between two units over standard connections, limiting the automation of field data retrieval. The only available method is manual copying via a PC, which adds extra steps and hardware requirements, decreasing efficiency and limiting the flexibility for mobile setups.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are seeking a direct and automated way to transfer SD card data between two [product_name] ([version_no]) devices without requiring a PC or manual handling.
